documentary_culture.name: DW Documentary
documentary_culture.long_description: DW Documentary delivers high-quality global documentaries covering politics, history, nature, technology, conflict zones, global culture, and social issues. Produced by Deutsche Welle, Germany’s international broadcaster.

documentary_culture.name: Arirang TV Culture
documentary_culture.long_description: Arirang Culture presents Korean arts, lifestyle, cultural discoveries, travel programming, documentaries, and Asia-focused cultural explorations.

documentary_culture.name: CGTN Documentary
documentary_culture.short_description: Documentaries from China and around the world.
documentary_culture.long_description: CGTN Documentary showcases long-form documentaries focused on China, Asia, wildlife, global development, history, and science. A mix of investigative and cultural programs.

documentary_culture.name: France 24 Documentaries
documentary_culture.long_description: France 24 Documentaries features investigative films, human-interest stories, geopolitical analysis, and international culture coverage. Content focuses on Europe, Africa, and the Middle East.

documentary_culture.name: Africanews Documentaries
documentary_culture.short_description: Documentaries & cultural features from across Africa.
documentary_culture.long_description: Africanews Documentary Channel highlights African culture, wildlife, innovation, human stories, and regional features that showcase diversity across the continent.

documentary_culture.name: RTVE Documentary
documentary_culture.long_description: Produced by Spain’s national broadcaster RTVE, this channel showcases cultural investigations, arts, travel, history, cuisine, and social documentaries.

documentary_culture.name: NHK World Japan
documentary_culture.long_description: NHK World Japan delivers documentaries on science, travel, Japanese culture, technology, food, global affairs, and Asia-focused news magazines.

documentary_culture.name: Smithsonian Channel FreeStream
documentary_culture.long_description: Smithsonian’s free FAST feed showcases American history, aviation, wildlife, ancient civilizations, paleontology, and curated Smithsonian Museum–backed knowledge.

documentary_culture.name: NatureVision TV
documentary_culture.long_description: NatureVision offers beautiful 4K nature scenery, wildlife footage, waterfalls, oceans, and ambient relaxation environments with no narration.

documentary_culture.name: Wild Planet TV
documentary_culture.long_description: Wild Planet TV shows continuous wildlife programming including safaris, oceans, jungles, animal behavior, and natural science explorations.
